description: Settlement/payment activity: the net amount Amazon settled over the window (major units) plus the all-time count of settlement/payment records synced per channel (a sync check, not money). For payouts on any channel use get_settlement_cycles; for orders not yet paid use get_unpaid_orders.

days.description: Lookback window for Amazon settled total (default 30).

name: get_payments_summary
title: Get payments / settlements summary
